review: Fresh full reccmp JSON includes instruction diffs for 18,725 configured ranges. 12,280 are exact, 261 effective matches, 6,184 differ. Rank by absolute changed instruction count and score; 494 have score >=90% and at most eight changed instructions per side.

Thirteen source functions are corrected from native instruction/value evidence, including one helper inlined into the Baku Altar owner. There is no blind replacement of assembly differences or global flag renumbering.
Native GAA_NONSICK is already zero; Freewind needs GAA_LITERAL_PROMPT. Native kill-code names/values are already correct; fix the specific Hydra/removal/range uses rather than swapping the enum.
Leave equivalent byte/word tests and signed shifts followed by byte masks alone. Hissing Iguanar loop counts start from BYTE0 and decrement toward zero; >0 and !=0 are equivalent there.

Do not change Oath of Nissa from the apparent zero/99 delta: native contains both return blocks, and the grouped diff aligned reordered blocks incorrectly. Branch displacement/padding changes, symbolic binding gaps and moved instructions remain separate queue items.

Routine C++ chooser coverage now binds current canonical source pins and current body hashes, preserving original review hashes and an explicit historical check. Bounds caches bind debug hashes, reader implementation and inclusion mode.

One incremental build and focused emitted-value/string checks follow. The JSON report is a pre-correction snapshot, not a claim that the rebuilt functions now score 100% or that all other differences are harmless.
scope: Evidence-driven small source corrections and a reusable comparison workflow. Not a byte-matching requirement or a transitive gameplay-equivalence claim.
